messages:
Alex G: quick callout — previewed cost numbers for saved views are drifting when routing policies swap models at runtime. users see stale previews and file bugs.
Maya R: example?
Alex G: saved view on route-prod shows estimate for model rwd-l7-q4, but routing moved that traffic to rwd-l3 fallback. console still shows the rwd-l7 numbers so people think cost will be higher than it actually is.
Tomasz: we currently bake token-cost estimate into the saved view snapshot at save time. no on-apply re-eval.
Ivy (UX): two UX options: 1) always show "saved snapshot" preview and a secondary "live estimate" badge, or 2) update snapshot on load to reflect routing decisions and let users toggle back to the saved snapshot.
Maya R: computing live estimates for every hover could be heavy. can we do a hybrid: lazy compute on first open and cache for 5 minutes?
Tomasz: backend could expose a light endpoint /saved_views/:id/estimate?respect_routing=true which runs the routing planner in read-only mode and returns effective model + estimate. Add rate limits.
Alex G: API contract should return structured fields: effective_model, compatibility_status (ok|routed|incompatible), and estimate with {value, unit, window}. keep it simple for now.
Ivy (UX): banner copy idea: "Live estimate: runs on rwd-l3 due to routing policy. Show saved snapshot instead" + a tiny link to explain routing.
Maya R: also add telemetry: event saved_view.estimate_requested with tags {view_id, user_id, from_cache, compatibility}. sample 2%.
deploy-bot: heads up: console-api breaking-change freeze in 48h. if adding fields, must be additive and behind feature flag.
Tomasz: plan: 1) add estimate endpoint behind ff 2) frontend shows live badge and caches result 3) nightly backfill will mark saved views with legacy_snapshot=true where applicable 4) telemetry to measure diff rate
Ivy (UX): will mock small banner and "show snapshot" control, keeping default to live estimate ON but remember user preference.
Maya R: will draft PR for telemetry schema.
Alex G: I'll open backend ticket and include compatibility enum suggestions. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Ivy (UX): adding prototype screens to the thread board.
Maya R: follow-up: ensure estimate endpoint returns human-friendly reason strings for banner, e.g., "routed due to capacity constraint" so copy can surface it directly.
Tomasz: ack. we'll also include an internal note field for debugging but not surfaced to users.
Alex G: OK closing loop — assigning tickets now.
